title: myTeamSpeak identities
changes: Optional myTeamSpeak sign-in on the Identities page, with selection dialogs for cloud downloads and uploads. This integration is experimental and still needs live-account verification.
File-based identity transfers are now clearly labeled Import file and Export file.
Cloud transfers skip existing identities rather than overwriting them. Passwords and cloud sessions are not saved to disk.

title: Smoother What's new
changes: What's new scrolls smoothly; it opens in the middle of the screen.
The compact update dialog is back, with buttons that fit on one line.

title: Quicker update checks
changes: New versions show up promptly even after your connection changes, for example when a VPN turns off.

title: Identity sync
changes: Upload and download identities on the Identities page: pick which ones, and keep the file on Google Drive or anywhere else.
Download also reads TS3 identity exports and app backups.

title: Earbuds mic by default again
changes: Bluetooth earbuds use their own mic and speakers by default again; you can switch the mic off in Settings.

title: A nicer update dialog
changes: The update dialog has clear, full-width buttons.
Updating always installs the newest version, even one published after the update was offered.

title: Less text while updating
changes: The update dialog no longer repeats what Android's install prompt already says.

title: Tidier update button
changes: A new version shows as a small blue download icon; its options open in the middle of the screen.

title: Cleaner versions, faster releases
changes: Versions read like v0.1.12 instead of 0.1.0+build.12.
New versions are published minutes after they're ready.
A sparkles icon for What's new.

title: Patch notes
changes: What's new: this page, next to your identities.
Server icons and avatars load first and retry when the server is busy.

title: Crash fix and calmer earbuds
changes: Joining servers whose welcome message has links (like tgts.ir) no longer crashes the app.
Bluetooth earbuds keep their noise cancelling: their mic is now opt-in under Settings, the phone mic is used by default.
Server icons and avatars that sometimes never appeared now load reliably.

title: Announcements and updates
changes: "Channel switched" is announced when you change channels.
The ts22.ir bookmark comes with its name and icon.
New versions show up within seconds; Check for updates is at the top of Settings.

title: Passwords and connecting
changes: Connecting no longer gets stuck: it gives up after 20 seconds and can be cancelled.
Voice keeps working after switching servers or reconnecting.
Pick your nickname on first launch.
Blue Update button on the server list when a new version is out.

title: In-app updates
changes: Update from inside the app, or save the new version to Downloads.
